description: REDEZEE - Carta Síntese D1 (Resiliência a mudanças climáticas) is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Esta informação foi produzida pela Secretaria de Infraestrutura e Meio Ambiente, no ano de 2022, durante o processo de elaboração do Zoneamento Ecológico-Econômico do Estado de São Paulo (ZEE-SP), instituído pelo Decreto Estadual n° 67.430, de 30 de dezembro de 2022. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Zoneamento, Ecológico, Econômico, ecologico, economico. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
